segments.name: Air transportation
segments.description: Copa Holdings' air transportation segment flies passengers, cargo and mail across North, Central and South America and the Caribbean from its Panama City hub.
segments.evidence: The Company's business activities are conducted as one operating segment – Air transportation (that includes cargo and mail revenue), the reporting results of which are regularly reviewed by management for purposes of analyzing its performance and making decisions about resource allocations.

revenueModel.text: Passengers and shippers pay Copa for air transportation, while partners pay for code-share access and for loyalty miles redeemed for future travel.
revenueModel.evidence: The significant contract liabilities are comprised of ticket sales for transportation that has not yet been provided

changes.text: In 2025 the Wingo operator La Nueva Aerolínea stopped passenger service and has conducted only freight operations since then.
changes.evidence: Since August 2025, La Nueva Aerolínea, S.A. has not conducted any passenger service and has exclusively conducted freight operations.
